scripts.check: pnpm openapi:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm --filter @ledgerly/api build && node tools/generate-openapi.mjs && openapi-typescript openapi/openapi.json -o packages/api-client/src/generated.ts --immutable --alphabetize
scripts.openapi:check: pnpm openapi:generate && git diff --exit-code -- openapi/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/generated.ts
